column1: # Rule: every heading, ATX (# to ######) or setext (text over === or ---), is a
# package named by its text with the closing # run, emphasis markers, code-span
# backticks and link syntax removed (a link keeps its text). Nothing else: no
# links, link reference definitions, code blocks, list items, tables, front
# matter, HTML blocks. A heading inside a block quote is still a heading.
